## What the user decided

Records accept, reject, or a different code, against suggestions the user
has actually been shown. It writes nothing to Xero.

Accepting stamps a hash of exactly what they were shown. Creating the
transaction later checks that hash again, so a suggestion that changed in
between is refused rather than created as something they never saw.

A suggestion with no code to accept cannot be accepted. That is the
needs-a-person case, and approving a blank is not a decision.
